cycleSardiniaEs.name: Group size
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Our tours are designed for small groups to ensure a safe, enjoyable, and high-quality experience. A minimum of 4 participants is required to organize the tour. The maximum number of participants is 14, which allows us to provide attentive service, maintain safety on the road, and ensure a personalized experience throughout the tour.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Price
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: The published price is based on the standard group size of 4 people. For larger groups, we may be able to offer a reduced price per person. Please contact us for a personalised quotation based on your group size and travel dates.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Difficulty
cycleSardiniaEs.text2: This tour is designed for a wide range of riders, making it an excellent choice for anyone with a reasonable level of fitness and some basic mountain biking experience. The Gorafe Desert trails are rated S1, featuring flowing double tracks with loose gravel, small rocks, and occasional erosion channels. There are no tight switchbacks, and gradients remain below 40%. Basic bike handling, braking, and balance skills are all that's needed to enjoy this spectacular desert landscape safely and comfortably.
cycleSardiniaEs.text3: Suitable for: Riders with basic MTB experience and a good level of fitness. No advanced technical skills are required.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Weather
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: The Sierra Nevada enjoys over 300 days of sunshine each year, making it an excellent destination for mountain biking throughout most of the year. We organize our MTB tours in spring, autumn, and winter, when temperatures are pleasant and ideal for outdoor activities. During the summer months, temperatures can become very high, especially at lower elevations, so we do not operate tours during this period. Thanks to the region's varied altitude, riders can enjoy comfortable conditions, spectacular views, and diverse landscapes in every season outside of summer.
